title: using airflow with Dbt debug: User does not have permissions for this command: "git"
answer:
For any other frustrated devs out there, it looks like only some dbt commands throw this error!

dbt debug is one of them and potentially dbt deps (though not tested). But the error you're seeing is because git --help is used here in the debug command. There's also a git.py file which is imported by other functions, so again this might impact other dbt commands.

If you're just running the usual commands like run, test, docs etc. You should be fine 👍

I've also tried installing git onto MWAA (version 2.6.3) but git isn't available (Source 1, Source 2) and I couldn't get instalation to work either.

I realise this isn't the best answer as it doesn't really solve anything, but hopefully this can stop any other devs from diving down the rabbit hole I went down 😅
